arrangement.title: Honk Orchestra
arrangement.provenance: User-approved 92 BPM composition: all 185 original melody pitch targets in 65 gestures with 36 bent holds, removing 19 Trigger presses from version 3. Phrases 2, 4 and 6 use the approved two-hold split: carry the G4 hold through F♯4–E4–D4, then a separate B3–A3 hold. Only the G4 melody Honk uses five-semitone range; wrist sensitivity is unchanged. The user plays melody; all 1,087 backing events run on prepared fixed-pattern Loopers. Full original 192-beat form. Unassigned pad tracks excluded.

trackMapping.sound: Original fixed boink profile; bass note-on rhythm

lessons.title: Melody phrase 1
lessons.goal: Play only the melody. Follow each rise and fall while holding Trigger; re-press for the next indicated note. The Loopers play the hi-hat, percussion, flute Honks and chords.

lessons.title: Melody phrase 2
lessons.goal: Play only the melody. In the repeated G4 passage, keep Trigger held through F♯4–E4–D4, then start a second hold on B3 and bend down to A3. The Loopers play the backing.
